# Hosted passthrough nightly

<!-- Generated by .github/scripts/hosted_passthrough_docs.py. Do not edit directly. -->

[Hosted Passthrough Nightly](../../.github/workflows/hosted-passthrough-nightly.yaml) runs on
`ubuntu-24.04` at cron `43 5 * * *` (UTC) and supports manual dispatch.
It builds Praxis from the workflow checkout and uses the
`OPENAI_API_KEY` Actions secret to call official OpenAI. A missing
secret fails the credential check before the build.

The [SDK suite](../../tests/integration/sdk/openai/test_openai_chat_completions_live.py) sends Chat Completions requests
through the local [Praxis configuration](../../tests/integration/fixtures/openai/chat-completions-live.yaml)
over TLS to OpenAI. It uses OpenAI Python `3.49.0` and model
`gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14`. It checks completions and token usage, streaming,
tool result continuation, and the upstream error for an unknown model.

To reproduce locally, build with `cargo build --locked -p praxis-ai-proxy`,
start `target/debug/praxis-ai -c tests/integration/fixtures/openai/chat-completions-live.yaml` from the
repository root, and set `OPENAI_API_KEY` in the shell that runs the SDK tests.

```bash
PRAXIS_LIVE_OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 \
  uv run --with pytest==8.4.2 --with openai==3.49.0 pytest \
  tests/integration/sdk/openai/test_openai_chat_completions_live.py
```

The run summary records the tested commit and configuration. The
`hosted-openai-passthrough-results` artifact contains JUnit results. Release CI
qualification records this lane when it finds a run for the exact release
commit. The tests forward the caller's provider key. Gateway authorization,
tenant isolation, credential injection, and retries are outside this suite.
